documents.title: Staff summary: Harbor Walk tax request

paragraphs: MADE-UP DEMO RECORD. Lantern Bay is a fictional city.
Harbor Walk is a proposed building of 120 homes on the Old Ferry lot. The owner, Harbor Walk Partners, has asked the City for help with property taxes.
The developer has agreed to set aside 12 of the 120 homes as affordable homes.
These homes would serve households at or below 60 percent of area median income.
MADE-UP DEMO RECORD. Lantern Bay is a fictional city.
Staff understands that the income limits would last for 30 years.
The written terms are still being prepared and are not attached to this summary.
Staff recommends that the Council support the request for a 20-year property tax reduction.
